## Core Services
1. Gel Extensions (Alongamento em Gel): Short/Medium (S/M) and Long (L) precision sculptured extensions.
2. Gel Overlay / Blindagem (Banho de Gel): Protective and strengthening gel layer over natural nails.
3. Advanced Pedicure with Russian Cuticle Care (Pedicure com Cutilagem Russa): Dry deep cuticle care using motorized diamond bits for flawless finish.
4. Pedicure with Gel Overlay (Pedicure com Banho de Gel): Long-lasting salon pedicure combined with strengthening gel.
5. Gel Refills / Maintenance (Manutenção S/M and L): Structural refills to maintain nail health and shape.
6. Refill from Another Artist (Manutenção de outra profissional): Safe structural cleanup and rebalance.
7. Safe Removal (Remoção segura): Complete, gentle removal preserving natural nail integrity.
8. Nail Art & Chrome: French / Babyboomer, minimalist nail art, nail jewels, and mirrored metallic chrome finish.

## Key Policies
- Punctuality: Grace period up to 10 minutes; arrivals beyond 10 minutes may require rescheduling to preserve client appointments.
- Rescheduling & Cancellations: Minimum 24 hours advance notice requested.
- Consultations & Hygiene: Hospital-grade sanitation, sterilized and disposable implements, strict health and safety protocols. Individual assessment is included with every service.
